instructions:
The principal wants a yes/no answer. Using ONLY the listed fields (refer to each as
latest("<ref>")), write a decision rule as a boolean expression with explicit thresholds, the conventional or
physical reason for each threshold, and short labels for yes and no. The rationale must hold on any day: do not
mention today's values in it. If an existing service already gives a
direct verdict or index, you may use it, but prefer rules that remain correct if one source is missing (use 'or' /
'and' deliberately). A field that holds several numbers (e.g. hourly values "30 20 10 0") can be given to max(),
min() or sum(), e.g. max(latest("src:field")) >= 50. Allowed functions: latest, max, min, sum, round, coalesce,
if_else, max_over, min_over. Do not invent fields. One or two rules at most.

questions.quantity: Verdict (yes/no) on whether today's daytime weather in Osaka favors outdoor line-drying: no rain or precipitation expected during drying hours, plus supportive conditions (low humidity, some wind/sun, comfortable temperature). Verdict is based on forecast for today's daylight drying hours.

payload.instruction: Each rule above was rejected for the stated reason. Values are compared as numbers only when they are numbers (a unit suffix like '%' is stripped); compare text values with ==. Write a rule that evaluates now.

expr.description: boolean expression using latest("ref") over the given refs, comparisons, and/or/not, numbers

rules.question: Is today a good day to dry laundry outside in Osaka?
rules.expr: latest("met_2_0_compact:properties.timeseries.0.data.next_1_hours.details.precipitation_amount") < 0.2 and latest("met_2_0_compact:properties.timeseries.0.data.next_6_hours.details.precipitation_amount") < 1 and latest("met_2_0_compact:properties.timeseries.0.data.instant.details.air_temperature") >= 12 and (latest("tenki_27100_3hours_html:laundry_index_today") == "大変よく乾く" or latest("tenki_27100_3hours_html:laundry_index_today") == "よく乾く" or (latest("met_2_0_compact:properties.timeseries.0.data.instant.details.relative_humidity") <= 65 and latest("met_2_0_compact:properties.timeseries.0.data.instant.details.wind_speed") >= 1.5))
rules.rationale: Laundry dries outdoors only if it stays rain-free, so forecast precipitation must be near zero (under 0.2 mm next hour, under 1 mm next 6 h). Air must not be too cold (12 °C or more) or evaporation is slow. Drying needs either tenki.jp's laundry index saying it dries well or dries very well, or independently dry air (RH at or below 65%, the usual point where evaporation is brisk) with at least a light breeze (1.5 m/s or more) to carry moisture away. The 'or' lets the rule work if the tenki.jp index is missing.

thresholds.why: Below measurable drizzle; clothes stay dry

Below this evaporation is too slow
Air dry enough for good evaporation

thresholds.threshold: == 大変よく乾く or よく乾く
